theme_and_archetype.tone: Professional, industrial, trustworthy, slightly utilitarian. Solid, confident, no-nonsense visual language with safety-yellow as the sharp accent.

primary.name: Charcoal
primary.usage: Sidebar background, headings, primary strong text, dark overlays.

secondary.name: Steel Blue
secondary.usage: Table headers, active states, secondary buttons, subtle borders, active icons.

accent.name: Safety Yellow
accent.usage: Primary CTAs, Key totals (Big AUD figure), active indicators. Always pair with charcoal text for high contrast.

typography.strategy: Swiss Minimalist constraint. Since Inter is required by spec, use tight tracking for headings and wide tracking for uppercase labels to avoid the generic SaaS look.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Control Room Grid - high density, clear boundaries.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen bg-[#1F2A33] text-white flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.header: h-16 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between px-8
layout_and_spacing.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded p-6 shadow-sm
layout_and_spacing.calculator_layout: grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Left inputs block: col-span-7. Right results panel: col-span-5 sticky top-8.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F5C518] text-[#1F2A33] font-bold px-6 py-2.5 rounded hover:bg-[#E0B416] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1F2A33] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#3A6B8C] text-white font-semibold px-6 py-2.5 rounded hover:bg-[#2C526B] transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-[#1F2A33] text-[#1F2A33] px-6 py-2.5 rounded hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors font-semibold

components.inputs: border border-gray-300 rounded px-4 py-2 text-sm focus:border-[#3A6B8C] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#3A6B8C] outline-none w-full

tables.wrapper: w-full text-sm text-left border border-gray-200 rounded overflow-hidden
tables.cell: px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white tabular-nums

components.badges: bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 uppercase rounded tracking-wider border border-gray-200

visual_enhancers.borders: Rely on sharp 1px solid borders instead of large drop shadows to delineate structure.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Sidebar links hover with bg-[#3A6B8C]/40 text-white. Tables have a subtle hover:bg-gray-50 on rows.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Keep animations crisp and under 200ms. No bouncy effects; this is professional industrial software.

image_urls.description: Black and white concrete wall texture. Usage: Place as a full viewport background on the login page with a heavy Charcoal (#1F2A33) overlay at 85% opacity to make the white login card pop.
Aerial view of an active construction site. Usage: Serve as a subtle background graphic inside the right half of the Dashboard Welcome Card, cleanly faded out to white on its left edge.

icons.style: Dense, highly legible, regular weight to match the industrial interface.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="calc-panel-type-select"`, `data-testid="calc-total-aud"`.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Write React components using .js/.jsx file extensions, NOT .tsx. The stack uses JavaScript.
Install standard Shadcn UI components and override styles (bg, text, ring) to match the brand palette. Use raw HTML/Tailwind where Shadcn components are too restrictive.

Sidebar structure: Wordmark 'Paneltec Group' at the top. Links: Dashboard, Calculator, Settings (Admin), Users (Admin). Mark Customers, Quotes, Jobs, Invoices as 'Coming soon' (disabled state + badge).

Precast Panel Calculator: Ensure all currency values are strictly formatted in AUD (e.g., $1,234.56). Create a prominent 'Big Total' block using the accent color (#F5C518) background. GST must be explicitly shown as a distinct line item (10%).

Results Panel Export: Implement an 'Export/Print' button that triggers `window.print()`. Add `@media print` CSS rules in the main stylesheet to hide the sidebar and header, leaving a clean calculator results view for paper/PDF.
Pricing Settings (Admin only): Render dense, editable numerical tables for panel types, concrete grades, and finish multipliers. Use `tabular-nums` for precise alignment.
Login Page: Center a clean white login card over the dark textured background image provided in the media section. Implement JWT auth mechanism handling.
Do not use placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the exact URLs from the `media` section.
